title_en: Until May 5, 1+1 apartment for sale, with a regular floor plan!!!
description_en: On May 5, 1+1 apartment for sale, with a regular floor plan!!! The apartment is located on the 2nd floor of a building with an elevator and has a gross area of ​​65.56 m2, of which 58.32 m2 is net. It is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom and 1 balcony. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
